{{Quote|Didn't expect to see you back so soon.|Li Preni to Han Solo|<ref name="RF: Uprising" />}}
'''Li Preni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nyemarian]] who worked at the [[South Anem Spaceport]]. He knew [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and watched over Solo's [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] when Solo arrived on [[Nyemari]] on a [[Mission to Nyemari|mission]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Preni met a [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphid]] who was looking for the Rebels, and told the [[Glymphid/Legends|alien]] the Rebels were in town. When Solo returned, Preni lied to him about the Glymphid, but told Solo the truth when the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] threatened him. The Rebels then left to meet the Glymphid themselves.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Was it that Farghul bounty hunter slug? You'd think he'd learned his lesson back on Iridonia.''"<br />"''Just some Glymphid. Offered a big bounty if anyone could point him toward the crew of the ''Falcon.''|Han Solo and Li Preni|<ref name="RF: Uprising" />}}
Li Preni was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nyemarian]] who had been fixing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] at the [[South Anem Spaceport]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. He had come to owe [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] a favor. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Solo convinced Preni to allow the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to dock at the South Anem Spaceport while Solo and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] conducted a the [[Mission to Nyemari|mission]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. While Solo and companions were snooping around the [[Nyemari Royal Palace]], Preni was met by a [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] who was tracking the Rebels; Preni told the alien the Rebels were in the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

After their mission was over, the Rebels returned to the Spaceport. Preni met them there but was surprised to see them there; he then told Solo someone was looking for the Rebels. Preni informed the Rebels he had not told the [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphidanything]], but a growl from [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] convinced the Nyemarian to tell the whole truth. The Rebels then left to confront the Glymphid, who was carrying a message for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from [[Rezi Soresh]]. Soresh "invited" Skywalker to come to his [[Unidentified dead red moon|outpost]], or Soresh would kill his hostages. Soresh then demonstrated his power when the Glymphid collapsed and [[Death/Legends|died]] from a type of time-released [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. Following the incident, the Rebels left Nyemari to [[Battle of the Sixela system|confront]] Soresh.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Character and traits==
{{Quote|Okay, okay! I may have told him you were in town. But I didn't say you were coming back today, I swear!|Li Preni after Chewbacca growls at him|<ref name="RF: Uprising" />}}
According to Han Solo, Preni would sell his own mother for a bottle of [[Lum/Legends|lum]], and may have sold out the Rebels to the Royal guards. When Preni met Solo after the mission, Preni's walk was shifty and up to no good, which did not surprise Solo. Preni lied to Solo about whether he had said anything about them. When threatened by Chewbacca, he revealed that he had in fact told the Glymphid that the Rebels were around.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
Li Preni appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.
